notes.text:
This update for avahi fixes the following issue:

- CVE-2026-34933: reachable assertion in `transport_flags_from_domain` can crash the `avahi-daemon` (bsc#1261546).

notes.text: Avahi is a system which facilitates service discovery on a local network via the mDNS/DNS-SD protocol suite. Prior to version 0.9-rc4, any unprivileged local user can crash avahi-daemon by sending a single D-Bus method call with conflicting publish flags. This issue has been patched in version 0.9-rc4.
